subject: Renewal prep: SOC 2 re-attestation + proposed capacity increase
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Wong <alice.w@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal prep: SOC 2 re-attestation + proposed capacity increase

Hi Alice —

Hope you're well. With ACME's Redwood subscription coming up for renewal in April, I wanted to align on two things we expect to cover as part of the renewal and expansion: SOC 2 re-attestation/evidence delivery and your proposed capacity increase (from current 4 to 8 reserved units).

Quick asks/notes so we can get the right owners engaged:
- Evidence scope: can you confirm whether ACME's security team expects a full re-scope for the capacity bump or if the current scope (prod endpoints + storage) is sufficient?
- Retention & audit logs: please confirm the retention window you need for audit logs (e.g., 90/180/365 days) and whether you require raw access to the log archive or an indexed export.
- Timeline: what is your procurement/PO timeline? We typically provide an evidence bundle (SOC 2 letter, evidence index, retention policy excerpt, sampled logs) within 7 business days once owners are assigned.
- Contract changes: the customer success / sales side is proposing a 24-month term amendment and the capacity bump; we can send a draft amendment + DocuSign link once you confirm procurement timing.

I've attached a short "evidence ask" checklist so you can see the artifacts we'll supply and what we may need from ACME. If it helps, we can do a 30-minute kickoff with your security and procurement this week.

Attachments: redwood_evidence_ask_v1.pdf

Thanks —
Aisha Rahman
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 415-555-0192

--
Redwood Inference | developer-first inference runtime

From: Alice Wong <alice.w@acme-analytics.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@acme-analytics.com
Date: Tue, 9 Feb 2027 11:05:14 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal prep: SOC 2 re-attestation + proposed capacity increase

Hi Aisha —

Thanks for the checklist. A few clarifications from our side:
- Retention: We need 365 days of immutable audit logs. For now we primarily need an indexed export (S3 prefix) we can ingest into our SIEM; raw logs alone are not sufficient unless accompanied by an index.
- Scope: Raising capacity will likely expand scope for the next attestation. Our security team will need confirmation whether the increased capacity will change the in-scope systems or if Redwood's existing controls cover the additional units.
- Legal/procurement: We prefer an invoice schedule aligned to quarter starts. Procurement would like the final amendment 30 days before renewal.

Can you share the evidence index and a sample of the retention policy excerpt? Also please include the expected format/location for logs (S3 prefix or secure transfer) and any redaction approach you take for customer-identifying fields.

Attachment: acme_sla_requirements_2027.pdf

Happy to jump on a quick call — would 10:00am PT on Thu work?

Best,
Alice Wong
Security Program Manager
Acme Analytics

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Renewal prep: SOC 2 re-attestation + proposed capacity increase

Marissa / Vivek —

Forwarding ACME's notes (below). They want 365-day immutable logs (indexed export), a sample retention-policy excerpt, and confirmation whether scope expands with the capacity increase. Procurement wants amendment 30 days prior; proposed kickoff call Thu 10:00am PT.

Can you:
- Marissa: prepare the evidence index + a retention policy excerpt we can hand to the customer, and confirm how we can deliver an indexed export (S3 prefix vs. secure SFTP). Also advise whether we can include sampled logs that are already redacted or if we need to produce a separate redaction process.
- Vivek: heads-up on procurement timing and whether quarter-aligned invoicing works for the proposed 24-month term amendment. Also let me know if legal needs changes to the SLA language to cover the capacity bump.

Target: reply to ACME with a single consolidated plan by EOD Thu so we can make the kickoff. Adding the HubSpot deal: HS-34567.

Thanks —
Aisha

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Feb 2027 14:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal prep: SOC 2 re-attestation + proposed capacity increase

Aisha / Vivek —

Ownership & plan below (high level):

1) Evidence index (owner: Marissa) — ETA: 3 business days
   - SOC 2 attestation letter (latest)
   - Control mappings and test evidence pointers
   - Retention policy excerpt (logs + backup retention)
   - Sample redacted audit log export (last 30 days)
   - Access logs (API + infra) pointers (S3 prefixes + object manifest)

2) Indexed export delivery (owner: Infra Ops, coordinated by Marissa) — ETA: 5 business days after index sign-off
   - We can provide an S3 prefix with an object manifest (.csv) for indexing, or a temporary secure SFTP transfer. Default: S3 prefix (s3://redwood-evidence/rdw-acme-2027/) with presigned manifests.
   - Redaction approach: replace customer-identifying fields with stable hashes; include a mapping key only if legal requires it under NDA.

3) Scope impact on attestation (owner: Marissa + Compliance Director) — initial assessment: capacity increase likely expands in-scope systems if new reserved pools are dedicated to ACME. If expansion uses existing shared pools, we may not need a full re-scope but will still need to document the change. Recommendation: mark as "probable re-scope" until infra confirms placement.

4) Procurement & amendments (owner: Vivek) — deliverable: draft amendment and DocuSign link; confirm invoice cadence.

Attachments: redwood_soc2_evidence_index.pdf

Next steps I propose:
- We produce the evidence index and retention excerpt by Fri EOD (local).
- Deliver a sample redacted log export with manifest within 5 business days.
- Aisha to confirm kickoff call Thu 10:00am PT and share final amendment timing.

I'll redact logs with a stable hash and produce a manifest for ACME's SIEM ingest. If we later need a formal attestation re-scope, we'll flag that to the customer and include the estimated timeline (typically 4–6 weeks).

-Marissa
Sr. Security Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Wong <alice.w@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, security@acme-analytics.com
Date: Fri, 12 Feb 2027 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal prep: SOC 2 re-attestation + proposed capacity increase

Alice —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Internal owners and a proposed timeline are below so you have a single plan:

- Evidence index & retention excerpt: Delivering redwood_soc2_evidence_index.pdf + retention_matrix.xlsx by Fri EOD (attached). Owner: Marissa Cole.
- Sample redacted log export: S3 prefix with manifest (s3://redwood-evidence/rdw-acme-2027/) within 5 business days after index sign-off. Redaction: stable hashing of customer identifiers; mapping key available under NDA.
- Scope: Marissa flagged "probable re-scope" if expansion uses dedicated pools; we will confirm placement this week and advise if a formal attestation update is required (target: 4–6 week window if re-scope needed).
- Contract: Vivek will draft the term amendment for a 24-month extension and capacity bump with quarter-aligned invoicing. DocuSign link will be shared in the HubSpot deal HS-34567.

Next steps:
1) Kickoff call Thu 10:00am PT (please confirm).
2) We'll send the evidence index + retention excerpt now (files attached).
3) We will follow up with S3 manifest & sample export; please confirm which SIEM ingest format you prefer (CSV manifest + gzipped JSON objects is our default).

Attachments: retention_matrix.xlsx, redwood_soc2_evidence_index.pdf

DocuSign (amendment draft): https://docusign.net/sign/ABC123
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/HS-34567

Look forward to the call.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0192
